problem: Film names had extra marks like '#' and '[a]'
why: Names must be the same in every source, or the join fails

problem: Money was text, like '₹1,350.83 crore' or a range like '₹90–130 crore'
action: Changed to a number in crore. For a range we took the middle value. Rows not converted: 0
why: We need numbers to do maths and make charts

problem: Same film had different names, like 'Saiyaara' and 'Saiyaara (film)', or 'Coolie (2025 film)'
action: Made one key for each film: small letters, removed '(film)' and '(2025 film)', spaces to '_', added '_2025'
why: With one key, all sources can be joined

problem: Films that did not match the box office table
action: Kept the film, left money empty
why: We should not make up a number

problem: Release date was text, like '14 February 2025' or a wiki code
why: We need the date to count days before and after release

action: Changed to a whole number of minutes

problem: Budget was missing or only given in US dollars
action: Left it empty. For a range we took the middle value
why: Budget numbers are guesses on Wikipedia. Filling them would make up data. We do not use budget in the main result

problem: Opening day money was not written in the article
why: This is a result number. Filling it would change the result

problem: Saiyaara's Wikipedia page was renamed on 4 Sep 2025. Before that its views were under the old name 'Saiyaara'
action: Added the views of the old name, only for dates before 4 Sep 2025
why: Without this, the biggest word-of-mouth hit of 2025 showed almost no views in release week

problem: Wikipedia counts views for each page name. Old names of a page (redirects) have their own views
action: Took views of every old name and added them to the film
why: Otherwise some films look less popular than they were

problem: Some days were missing in the views and edits data
why: The website skips a day only when nothing happened that day, so 0 is correct

problem: We had views from Nov 2024 to Feb 2026
action: Kept only 30 days before to 60 days after release
why: Same time window for every film, so the comparison is fair

problem: The Wikipedia page was made less than 7 days before release. So views before release show 0, but only because the page did not exist
action: Left 'views before release' empty for: junior_2025, saiyaara_2025, su_from_so_2025
why: 0 views and 'page did not exist' are not the same thing

problem: Critic text had wiki codes, links and repeated lines
action: Removed codes, links and @names. Removed very short and repeated lines. 217 lines left
why: The sentiment tool needs clean sentences. Also we must not keep people's user names

problem: Some film pages had no critic review section
action: Kept the film, left critic score empty
why: We should not make up a score

problem: Films are very different in size (Rs 16 crore to Rs 1,350 crore)
action: Used log and z-score. Also made 'money per 1,000 views'
why: So a small Kannada film and a big Hindi film can be compared fairly
